newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: World forum votes for African ivory trade.
newsitem.headline: World forum votes for African ivory trade.

text.p: A world conference on endangered species voted on Thursday in favour of a proposal by three southern African states to conditionally allow them to trade in ivory.
The 10-day Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) backed arguments that the trade would not endanger elephants worldwide.
Seventy six voted for the proposal from 117 countries that took part, and 21 voted against. There were 20 abstentions in the secret ballot on the proposal by Zimbabwe, Botswana and Namibia.
